completeValue = (value?: string | boolean | null): void => {\n    const c = parent();\n    if (!c) {\n      rootClosed = true;\n      return;\n    }\n    if (c.kind === \"object\") {\n      if completeValue = (value?: string | boolean | null): void => {\n    const c = parent();\n    if (!c) {\n      rootClosed = true;\n      return;\n    }\n    if (c.kind === \"object\") {\n      if (stack.length === 1 && c.key === \"type\" && typeof value === \"string\") eventType = value;\n      if (stack.length === 1 && c.key === \"willRetry\" && typeof value === \"boolean\") willRetry =
